sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43:1
items.html: Completely under the place of Malchut de Atzilut. Under the place of the new Tzimtzum where Behinat Atzilut ends and the place of the Separated Olamot begins.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43:2
items.html: Their place under Sefirat Bina remained vacant. This is so because the GAR, which are KHB, remained, and only the Melachim from Bina down broke and left a vacant space. After the Tikun, that will be the place where Olam Atzilut will stand.
